summary: Broaden the ruḥo idiom gloss to include literal killing and retain figurative annoyance.
before: ʻden Nerv töten, den letzten Nerv raubenʼ
after: ʻjemandem das Leben nehmen, töten; fig. jemandem den letzten Nerv raubenʼ
rationale: Completed killing at 60/332 and the already quoted murder threat 76/99 require literal life-taking; JTM refugee/annoyance contexts independently support the figurative branch. Preserve all example text and the inherited editorial note.

summary: Restore the second-person plural possessive on city.
rationale: The supplied verse reads 'šəqlilxu i walayaṯxu naqla ḥreto', with the noun marked 'your (plural) city'. The entry retains the surrounding clause but replaces that noun with unpossessed walaye, losing the possessive ending.

summary: Restore our cook instead of my cook.
rationale: The supplied Turoyo reads 'U aščiyayḏan', and both the entry and edition translations say 'unser Koch'. The entry's -ayḏi is the first-person singular possessive instead of plural -ayḏan.

summary: Recording-action noun is active Infinitiv sense 6, not Detransitive sense 1.

summary: New sense 1b: (von Sinnesorganen) Geruch, Geschmack aufnehmen, wahrnehmen

summary: New sense 2b: (mit l-) jemandem eine Frau verschaffen
rationale: The father is the acquiring agent, the son the l-marked beneficiary, and the woman the indexed object. The acquiring agent does not marry her.

summary: New sense 6b: (von einem elektrischen Hörgerät) Schall aufnehmen
rationale: One attestation; the hearing device picks up sound without any claim of storage. This differs from the recording meaning of 6.

summary: New sense 1c: (ein Verkehrsmittel) nehmen, benutzen
rationale: Vehicle object with marke and travel goal identifies taking transport, not buying the vehicle. One clear attestation; no claim that payment or renting is entailed.

summary: New idiom: šqile/šoqəl u=mamro (mit mən-) ‘jemandem im Ratespiel das Wort entziehen’

summary: New idiom: šqile/šoqəl faġro ‘die Kommunion empfangen’ (cf. qurbono)

data.translation: Nun war unser Mann, Schamun, ein guter Christ, und bei uns geht es nicht an, daß ein Christ vierzig Tage verstreichen läßt, ohne den leih des Herrn zu empfangen; nach den Gesetzen unserer Kirche ist es so.

rationale: Sacramental-body variant of inherited communion idiom; no technical numbered sense.

summary: Taking/buying objects are normally zero-marked; Preterit agents can be l-marked nouns doubled by L-suffixes (Bilgic 20, JTM 5.2/73). Infectum spouse and beneficiary L-suffixes need clause-specific interpretation.
Money received as wages, bath fees, debt repayment or levies belongs to 5. Buyers acquire commodities under 3; generic obtain remains 1 when transaction evidence is absent.

Preterit-wa supplies anterior purchases, collection and control; Infectum-wa covers habitual buying, seizure and collection. PrS 14/8 is an unrealized exchange outcome, already represented by the inherited prs 30/5 example.
Active šqolo action nouns were inherited under Detransitive Infinitiv. Proposed moves separate them from true məšqolo Detransitive Infectum; inherited Detransitive senses lack an explicit gloss list.
Routine counts, shared by the two šql batches, chiefly attest 1,2,3; they are counted once as background frequencies, not as example counts or unreviewed individual decisions.

Turkish puwane provides a contact-related credit collocation; the interviewer's correction of the officer episode limits its evidential value, while the student episode independently supports receiving points.

Batch 2 continues batch 1 cumulatively. Existing 1b,2b,6b and all earlier decisions are retained; 1c is the next construction label, not a renumbering. Aggregate routine counts are the same shared root evidence and are not summed again.

Give-and-take interaction in conversation, bargaining, blows, silence and trade is already registered under hyw 1; cross-reference that entry rather than duplicating its idiom at šql (30/105,53/85,76/154,94/522,97/73,99/77).

Mother/father m-sources in the reason-loss idiom (67/201) contrast with l-marked divine agent. Statement-taking at 89/118 and Talay 1/342 has investigators as agents, while the woman is possessor of the testimony, despite the edition translation.
The rear-position and news proposals overlap the preceding batch's accepted collocations; broaden their government/variants and retain one example per idiom.
Several unusual-looking forms are likely transcription/person discrepancies (29/167,30/120), so they are retained as questions rather than added as secure paradigm evidence.
JTM 2.7/15: is šəqlinawolən a q/l transposition for boil (šlq)? Do not publish it as a cooking sense or a secure taking example until edition/audio resolves this.
JTM 5.2/38: is d šuqlo d saymo an independent undertake construction or a restarted take-clause? Evidence does not yet justify a numbered sense.
Confirm the intended readings and segmentation of šqə́llanne (MAC YT 75), Šqəllanne (PrS 18/14), Šqulxu (PrS 36/115), šqulənne (PrS 43/90), and Šqəlili (PrS 62/112); preserve printed forms.
Confirm reported-person morphology at Bilgic 15 and feminine agent versus edition perspective at JTM 5.3/30; neither requires changing the marriage sense.

Check source-number correspondences Hors 1/25 ~ EL 25, Hors 2/71 ~ MM 71, PrS 26/2 ~ prs 62/27, PrS 73/29 ~ prs 210/29, PrS 14/8 ~ prs 30/5. The matching text supports duplicate recognition but not automatic citation replacement.
Does PrS 14/8 rabṯo establish an error in inherited barṯo in šql.I.t.infectum-wa.3? Check edition before altering the quotation.
Clarify exact force and counterpart mən- of u=darbo d-aloho; the evidence establishes a nonliteral moral/conciliatory expression, not physical travel.
Can the missing Detransitive sense gloss 1 be supplied for existing soul/seizure examples? Retain existing numbering meanwhile.
Confirm source/agent suffixing at Bilgic Die Rolle 47, grain-acquisition reading of dšoqalni (MAC NI 91), and the antecedent/instrument of ebe (MAC NE Famine 64).
3/38: confirm the tongue antecedent in the edition; the supplied one-line verse has no expressed organ subject. Its taste object is secure.
69/438: does gšoqanna already index her, with soz a parenthetical assurance? A distinct make-one's-own-promise idiom is not established; compare the following explicit d šoqannola.
60/231: does taking i ḍarbo mine mean gaining an opening, receiving a blow or parrying? Withhold a combat sense from German alone.
63/100: is imano literal religious faith or an exasperation idiom? Published proposal retains only the edition-supported faith gloss.
Check transcription/person at 23/17 (Šqile vs inherited šqəlle), 29/167 (gšəqli vs expected address), 30/120 (šqile vs speaker šqili), 55/48 (mine inside ono thought), and 96/210 (kšəqlallux).
29/50 verse_translation includes material labeled 051 after the matching farewell sentence. No translation from the appended verse is quoted.
Verify whether inherited LB 198 and Talay 1/198 are the same mantle quotation; likewise Detransitive 26/182 and Part act. 43/55 are already represented and have not been duplicated.
115/131 has šqili hawa while the nfq cross-quotation reportedly has mbeli. Check the edition before changing an existing source quotation.
Correct widergefunden to wiedergefunden.
rationale: The intended meaning is finding one's energy again, as the idiom gloss 'Energie wiederfinden' itself confirms. Wiedergefunden requires wieder-, not wider-.

summary: Taking the soul covers literal death-taking and figurative exhaustion; JTM 3.2/23 and 4.4/2 support the inherited ruḥo idiom's figurative branch.
Recorded objects include voices, stories and songs; material variation does not create new senses.
Animals can be the agents of the established i=raḥa rest collocation.
Weeds can deprive grain of strength (i humma mu zad): abstract resource and plant participants, not a new lexical sense.
Literal property loss with l aloho šqile meni (43/40) must be distinguished from the formally similar loss-of-reason idiom.
The distance collocation accepts a filly as agent; retain the edition's motion rendering without making leaping an independent meaning of šql.
